critique.evidence: The screen supports an operational defense story with PR-AUC, constrained-FPR recall, calibration, alert load, latency, confusion counts, value caught/blocked, and ablations. However, it does not visibly connect these results to Mastercard’s payment-network use case or show that intent-integrity attacks are what was evaluated. Dataset provenance, sample size/splits, attack taxonomy, baseline comparison, confidence or repeated-run evidence, and metric definitions are absent. The precision–recall chart also shows unusable repeated “100%” x-axis labels, weakening the core claim.
critique.fix: Add a compact evidence panel identifying the payment scenario, intent-integrity attack classes, dataset and holdout sizes, evaluation protocol, baseline/current-defense comparison, and uncertainty across runs. Tie money metrics to a stated currency and transaction population, and repair the PR chart axes so judges can validate the result.
